name: vfx-magnetic
title: Magnetic Cursor
description: A page drawn through a WebGL shader that warps every pixel toward a moving cursor, with a Gaussian falloff and a little chromatic aberration, plus a repel pulse. Four captions explain what is happening.
useWhen: A demo of an interactive-looking page where pixels bend toward a cursor, for tech and product videos.
A text-and-cards screen that should feel alive without changing its layout.
avoidWhen: The shot is just a backdrop with no content: the shader only bends the built-in page.
You need the effect on your own video footage: copy the shader into your composition and feed it your frame as a texture.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Heading
variables.description: Headline of the page. Words wrapped in [square brackets] get the accent colour.

variables.label: Paragraph 1
variables.default: Move your mouse across this page. Every pixel is drawn through a WebGL shader that warps space toward your cursor position, like a magnet pulling iron filings beneath a thin rubber sheet.

variables.label: Paragraph 2
variables.default: The distortion follows a Gaussian falloff: strong at close range, tapering smoothly to nothing. The text remains readable even under deformation.

variables.label: Hint line
variables.description: Small monospace line above the cards.
variables.default: WebGL2 shader distortion over a live page

variables.label: Cards
variables.description: Up to 3 cards as "Title | description", separated by semicolons.
variables.default: Real-time | 60fps distortion over the whole page in one shader pass; Crisp type | The page is drawn at full fidelity before it is bent; GPU shaders | Gaussian warp plus chromatic aberration in one fragment shader

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Four lines shown one after another at the bottom, separated by semicolons.
variables.default: The whole page is drawn through a WebGL shader; A magnetic shader warps every pixel toward the cursor; Chromatic aberration splits RGB channels at the distortion site; A repel pulse pushes the page away again

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent words, card icons and the cursor dot.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Text edges need 0.75.
